name: Son La Dam
kicker: Dam and reservoir on the Da
summary: Look at the dam from the public side, then leave. One page says that view is free and the plant below is closed. Another says register ahead for a visit of about two to three hours. The drive is about 40 km on two pages and about 60 km on a third. Check the gate on arrival.
timeNeeded: A half day from the city
getThere: Highway 279 north. About 40 km, or about 60 km.
heroCaption: The dam wall at It Ong, the Da below it, and the ridges behind

notice.title: The visit rules disagree
notice.body: One page says the plant below the dam is closed and the outside look is free. A 2026 note says register ahead for a visit of about 2–3 hours, free or very low. Check which door is open.

body: Stand on the public side and look at the wall. The plant is at Ít Ong, Mường La, on the Đà, not in the town center. EVN inaugurated it on 23 December 2012. Installed capacity is 2,400 MW, six units of 400 MW. The reservoir is 9.26 billion m³. Normal level 215 m, surcharge 217.83 m, dead water 175 m. The gravity dam is 138.1 m high, with a crest of 961.6 m. A second EVN page adds crest elevation 228.1 m, base width 105 m, and crest width 10 m.

One reservoir page prints a lake surface of 224 km² at design level. The EVN release does not print that surface, so 224 km² stays as that page’s figure. The handbook and the reservoir page put the dam about 40 km and about one hour north of the city. sonlatour.vn prints about 60 km from the city center. The one-hour figure belongs to the 40 km account. Minutes for the 60 km figure are check on arrival.

The reservoir page says an outside look takes about 30–45 minutes and that the plant below the dam is closed. A 2026 note says register ahead, that a visit takes about 2–3 hours, and that the cost is free or very low. Do not plan a tour inside the powerhouse from the first of those pages. Boat tours on the reservoir page run 7:00–17:00, for 2–3 hours on the water. A boat fee is check on arrival. That page names October–April as the dry months and suggests early morning or late afternoon for the viewpoint. That season is one page. The dam is the half-day north of town. It is not the picture of the night under Khau Ca.

figures.caption: The reservoir side of the dam, with the crest and the hills
figures.alt: The Son La Dam from the reservoir, with the concrete crest, an orange gate, and forested hills

gettingThere: Leave the valley on Highway 6, then take Highway 279 north to Mường La. The 2020 handbook and the reservoir page say about 40 km and about one hour. sonlatour.vn says about 60 km from the city center. Keep both distances. Minutes for the 60 km figure are check on arrival. A taxi fare and a motorbike hire on one commercial page belong to the 40 km account. Do not treat that fare as the price for the 60 km account. The fare is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Son La
legs.body: Highway 279 north to Mường La. About 40 km and about one hour on the handbook and the reservoir page, or about 60 km on sonlatour.vn. Minutes for 60 km are check on arrival.

hours: Boat tours on the reservoir page run 7:00–17:00. That page describes an outside look of about 30–45 minutes. A 2026 note says a plant visit takes about 2–3 hours.
closed: The plant below the dam is closed on the reservoir page. The 2026 note does not say that. Check the gate on arrival.
admissionNote: The reservoir page describes the outside view as free. A 2026 note says the cost is free or very low and that visitors should register ahead. A current gate tariff is check on arrival. The same reservoir page prices a boat at 400,000–1,000,000 VND, or a group seat at 350,000–650,000 VND. Those prices are one commercial page. A boat fee is check on arrival.
